cards.en: What is your name?
cards.example_en: My name is Minh.

cards.en: How old are you?
cards.example_en: I am 27 years old.

cards.en: Where do you live?
cards.example_en: I live in Helsinki.

cards.en: Where are you from?
cards.example_en: I am from Vietnam.
cards.note: Use 'olen kotoisin' + country in the -sta/-stä case.

cards.en: What do you do for a living?
cards.example_en: I work as a software developer.

cards.en: What hobbies do you have?
cards.example_en: I like reading and jogging.

cards.en: How long have you lived in Finland?
cards.example_en: I have lived in Finland for three years.

cards.en: Why do you study Finnish?
cards.example_fi: Opiskelen suomea, koska asun ja työskentelen Suomessa.
cards.example_en: I study Finnish because I live and work in Finland.

cards.en: What kind of person are you?
cards.example_en: I am a calm and friendly person.

cards.en: Where do you work?
cards.example_en: I work at a big technology company.

cards.en: What do you do for a living?
cards.example_en: I am a software developer.

cards.fi: Mihin aikaan aloitat ja lopetat työpäiväsi?
cards.en: What time do you start and finish your workday?
cards.example_fi: Aloitan työni kello kahdeksan ja lopetan kello neljä.
cards.example_en: I start work at eight and finish at four.

cards.en: Do you like your job? Why?
cards.example_fi: Pidän työstäni, koska se on mielenkiintoista.
cards.example_en: I like my job because it is interesting.
cards.note: Answer 'pidän' or 'en pidä' and explain with 'koska'.

cards.en: Have you ever been unemployed?
cards.example_en: Yes, I was unemployed for half a year.
cards.note: Answer with 'kyllä' or 'en ole' + perfect/past tense.

cards.en: Where do you study?
cards.example_en: I study Finnish at the adult education centre.

cards.en: What subjects do you study?
cards.example_en: I study Finnish and mathematics.

cards.en: What is your favourite subject?
cards.example_en: My favourite subject is Finnish.

cards.en: What would you like to study in the future?
cards.example_en: In the future I would like to study business.

cards.en: What is your dream profession?
cards.example_en: My dream profession is a doctor.

cards.en: What do you do in your free time?
cards.example_fi: Vapaa-ajallani luen kirjoja ja tapaan ystäviä.
cards.example_en: In my free time I read books and meet friends.

cards.en: Do you go to the movies?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, käyn elokuvissa noin kerran kuukaudessa.
cards.example_en: Yes, I go to the movies about once a month.
cards.note: Answer 'kyllä, käyn' or 'en käy' + how often.

cards.en: Do you read books?
cards.example_en: Yes, I gladly read novels.
cards.note: Use 'luen' + 'mielelläni' to say you enjoy it.

cards.en: Do you do sports?
cards.example_en: Yes, I do sports three times a week.

cards.en: What kind of music do you like?
cards.example_en: I like calm pop music.

cards.en: Do you watch television? What programmes?
cards.example_en: I watch television and I like documentaries.
cards.note: Name programme types after saying what you watch.

cards.en: Do you go to restaurants?
cards.example_en: I go to a restaurant sometimes on weekends.
cards.note: Add a frequency word like 'joskus' or 'usein'.

cards.en: What do you do on weekends?
cards.example_en: On weekends I rest and meet my friends.

cards.en: Do you have a pet?
cards.example_en: Yes, I have a cat.

cards.en: What is your favourite hobby?
cards.example_en: My favourite hobby is photography.

cards.en: How many people are in your family?
cards.example_en: There are four people in my family.

cards.en: What kind of relationship do you have with your parents?
cards.example_en: I have a close relationship with my parents.

cards.en: Do you have siblings?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, minulla on yksi veli ja yksi sisko.
cards.example_en: Yes, I have one brother and one sister.

cards.en: What does your family do together?
cards.example_en: My family travels and eats together.

cards.en: How often do you meet your friends?
cards.example_en: I meet my friends every week.

cards.en: What do you do with your friends?
cards.example_fi: Ystävieni kanssa käyn kahvilla ja ulkoilen.
cards.example_en: With my friends I go for coffee and walk outside.

cards.en: What is most important in friendship?
cards.example_en: The most important thing in friendship is trust.

cards.en: What is a good friend like?
cards.example_fi: Hyvä ystävä on rehellinen ja luotettava.
cards.example_en: A good friend is honest and reliable.

cards.en: Where did you meet your best friend?
cards.example_en: I met my best friend at school.

cards.en: Who do you like to spend time with?
cards.example_en: I like to spend time with my family.

cards.en: What time do you wake up on weekdays?
cards.example_en: On weekdays I wake up at six o'clock.

cards.en: What do you eat for breakfast?
cards.example_fi: Syön aamiaiseksi puuroa ja juon kahvia.
cards.example_en: For breakfast I eat porridge and drink coffee.

cards.en: How do you get to work or school?
cards.example_en: I go to work by bus.

cards.en: What do you do in the evening?
cards.example_en: In the evening I watch TV and read.

cards.en: What do you do at home on weekends?
cards.example_fi: Kotona viikonloppuisin siivoan ja laitan ruokaa.
cards.example_en: At home on weekends I clean and cook.
cards.note: Use home activities: siivoan, laitan ruokaa.

cards.en: What kind of housework do you do?
cards.example_fi: Teen kotitöitä, kuten siivoan ja pesen pyykkiä.
cards.example_en: I do housework, such as cleaning and washing laundry.

cards.en: What do you buy from the shop?
cards.example_en: I buy food and drinks from the shop.

cards.en: Where do you do your shopping?
cards.example_en: I do my shopping at the local shop.

cards.en: Do you often go to the library?
cards.example_en: I go to the library about once a week.

cards.en: How do you spend your holiday?
cards.example_en: I spend my holiday travelling and resting.

cards.en: Do you go to the doctor often?
cards.example_fi: En käy lääkärissä usein, vain kun olen sairas.
cards.example_en: I don't go to the doctor often, only when I'm sick.

cards.en: When were you last sick?
cards.example_en: I was last sick last month.

cards.fi: Mitä teet, jos sinulla on kuumetta?
cards.en: What do you do if you have a fever?
cards.example_fi: Jos minulla on kuumetta, lepään ja juon vettä.
cards.example_en: If I have a fever, I rest and drink water.
cards.note: Start with 'jos minulla on kuumetta,' then actions.

cards.en: Do you eat healthily?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, syön paljon vihanneksia ja hedelmiä.
cards.example_en: Yes, I eat a lot of vegetables and fruit.

cards.en: Do you exercise regularly?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, liikun säännöllisesti neljä kertaa viikossa.
cards.example_en: Yes, I exercise regularly four times a week.

cards.en: How do you take care of your health?
cards.example_fi: Hoidan terveyttäni liikkumalla ja nukkumalla hyvin.
cards.example_en: I take care of my health by exercising and sleeping well.
cards.note: Use the -malla/-mällä form to say 'by doing'.

cards.en: Have you been in hospital?
cards.example_en: Yes, I was in hospital once as a child.

cards.en: When did you last have a cold?
cards.example_en: I last had a cold in the winter.

cards.en: How do you keep yourself fit?
cards.example_fi: Pidän itseni kunnossa urheilemalla joka päivä.
cards.example_en: I keep myself fit by doing sports every day.

cards.en: Do you go to the gym?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, käyn kuntosalilla kaksi kertaa viikossa.
cards.example_en: Yes, I go to the gym twice a week.

cards.en: Where do you go grocery shopping?
cards.example_en: I go shopping near my home.

cards.en: What do you usually buy from the shop?
cards.example_fi: Ostan yleensä leipää, maitoa ja vihanneksia.
cards.example_en: I usually buy bread, milk and vegetables.

cards.en: Do you go to flea markets?
cards.example_en: Yes, I go to the flea market sometimes.

cards.en: How do you pay for your purchases?
cards.example_en: I usually pay for my purchases by card.

cards.en: Do you go to cafés?
cards.example_en: I often go to a café with my friends.

cards.en: What do you buy as a gift for a friend?
cards.example_en: I buy a book as a gift for a friend.

cards.en: Have you bought from an online shop?
cards.example_en: Yes, I have bought clothes from an online shop.

cards.en: What do you think about online shops?
cards.example_fi: Mielestäni verkkokaupat ovat helppoja ja käteviä.
cards.example_en: In my opinion online shops are easy and convenient.
cards.note: Start with 'mielestäni' to give an opinion.

cards.en: How do you handle your banking?
cards.example_en: I handle my banking in online banking.

cards.en: How do you pay the rent?
cards.example_en: I pay the rent in online banking every month.

cards.en: Do you often travel?
cards.example_en: Yes, I often travel in the summer.

cards.en: Where have you been?
cards.example_en: I have been to Sweden and Estonia.
cards.note: Use perfect tense 'olen käynyt' + places in -ssa/-ssä.

cards.en: What is your dream travel destination?
cards.example_en: My dream travel destination is Japan.

cards.en: How do you travel in Finland?
cards.example_en: I usually travel in Finland by train.

cards.en: Have you been to Lapland?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, olen käynyt Lapissa kerran talvella.
cards.example_en: Yes, I have been to Lapland once in the winter.
cards.note: Use perfect tense 'olen käynyt' or 'en ole käynyt'.

cards.en: Do you like air travel?
cards.example_fi: Pidän lentomatkustamisesta, koska se on nopeaa.
cards.example_en: I like air travel because it is fast.

cards.en: What do you travel to work by?
cards.example_en: I travel to work by bus.

cards.en: Do you have a driving licence?
cards.example_en: Yes, I have a driving licence.
cards.note: Use 'minulla on' or 'minulla ei ole ajokorttia'.

cards.en: Have you used the train in Finland?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, olen käyttänyt junaa usein Suomessa.
cards.example_en: Yes, I have used the train often in Finland.

cards.en: Do you use a bicycle?
cards.example_en: Yes, I use a bicycle in the summer.

cards.en: What is the weather like today?
cards.example_en: Today it is sunny and warm.

cards.en: What is your favourite season?
cards.example_en: My favourite season is summer.

cards.en: Do you like winter?
cards.example_en: I like winter because I like snow.

cards.en: What do you do in the summer?
cards.example_fi: Kesällä uin ja vietän aikaa mökillä.
cards.example_en: In the summer I swim and spend time at the cottage.

cards.en: Do you think climate change is a serious issue?
cards.example_fi: Mielestäni ilmastonmuutos on hyvin vakava asia.
cards.example_en: In my opinion climate change is a very serious issue.

cards.en: Do you go to the forest?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, käyn metsässä kävelemässä joka viikko.
cards.example_en: Yes, I go walking in the forest every week.

cards.en: Does Finland have clean nature?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, Suomessa on hyvin puhdas luonto.
cards.example_en: Yes, Finland has very clean nature.

cards.en: What can you do for the environment?
cards.example_fi: Voin kierrättää ja käyttää julkista liikennettä.
cards.example_en: I can recycle and use public transport.

cards.en: Do you recycle?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, kierrätän paperia, lasia ja muovia.
cards.example_en: Yes, I recycle paper, glass and plastic.

cards.en: What do you think about Finnish nature?
cards.example_fi: Mielestäni suomalainen luonto on kaunis ja rauhallinen.
cards.example_en: In my opinion Finnish nature is beautiful and peaceful.

cards.en: What did you eat last?
cards.example_en: Last I ate soup and bread.
cards.note: Use past tense 'söin' + food in partitive.

cards.en: What is your favourite food?
cards.example_en: My favourite food is fish soup.

cards.en: Can you cook?
cards.example_fi: Kyllä, osaan laittaa ruokaa melko hyvin.
cards.example_en: Yes, I can cook quite well.

cards.en: What do you usually do on your birthday?
cards.example_en: On my birthday I spend time with family.

cards.en: How do you celebrate Christmas?
cards.example_fi: Juhlin joulua perheeni kanssa ja syömme hyvää ruokaa.
cards.example_en: I celebrate Christmas with my family and we eat good food.

cards.en: How do you celebrate Easter?
cards.example_en: I celebrate Easter quietly at home.

cards.en: What is a good neighbour like?
cards.example_fi: Hyvä naapuri on ystävällinen ja auttavainen.
cards.example_en: A good neighbour is friendly and helpful.

cards.en: How often do you clean at home?
cards.example_en: I clean at home once a week.

cards.en: What would you like to learn in the future?
cards.example_en: I would like to learn to play the piano.

cards.fi: Missä näet itsesi viiden vuoden päästä?
cards.en: Where do you see yourself in five years?
cards.example_fi: Viiden vuoden päästä näen itseni hyvässä työssä Suomessa.
cards.example_en: In five years I see myself in a good job in Finland.
cards.note: Start with 'viiden vuoden päästä' + future plan.
